$comment: #EXP-1381 (owner 2026-10-24): THE TEAM PAGE'S SETTINGS ROWS ×3 phones (iOS SettingsView team section, Android TeamTabScreen, web-mobile routes/t/$teamSlug/team.tsx), derived from web SETTINGS_NAV (settings/-shared.tsx) in its order. `rows` = every team category in order: `id` (the route segment: web `/t/$teamSlug/settings/<id>`, Android `team-settings/<id>`, iOS `TeamSettingsSection` / AppRoute), `label` = the row's title AND its page's title, `icon` = the concept, `group` = the SETTINGS_NAV group it comes from, `visible` = who sees the row (all | manageTeam = an owner or a member with team management | cloudManageTeam = that on a cloud instance | manageWidgets), `phone` = the row is on EVERY phone's Team page (false = web-only pages, shown on web-mobile's Team page after the phone rows of their group, never on the natives), `count` = the trailing count (members, boards, agents). EACH ROW OPENS ITS OWN PAGE: its own header (`label` as the title, a back control), only that category's content, observing only that category's data; never the page of all sections and never a scroll-to inside it. General = the team's identity (name, avatar) + the Danger zone (delete team, owner only); Boards = the team's boards (a row opens the board's settings) + New board; Agents = the agents (a row opens the agent's settings) + New agent; Devices = the devices page (moved here from the phone tab bar, chats.json `shell`). Apps are NOT a row (the phones' Apps tab). The account/servers/General rows after this group stay as they are per platform. Web ≥ md keeps its settings sidebar (SETTINGS_NAV); on web < md the settings pages wear the phone detail header (mobile-detail-header.tsx: back to the Team page + the title), never the h1 + the strip of every category. Mirrors (generated by packages/domain-contract/scripts/generate.ts from this file): iOS ExpCore `SettingsNav.swift`, Android `domain/SettingsNav.kt`, TS `src/settings-nav.ts`; every platform's test replays `rows` and `phoneRows`.
